name: Jhoira
description: Jhoira is an ancient artificer of Dominaria, formerly of Tolarian Academy, who became captain of the rebuilt Weatherlight and is a friend of Karn, Teferi and Jodah.

description_citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

description_citations.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

summary.text: Jhoira is an ancient artificer of Dominaria, formerly of Tolarian Academy, who became captain of the rebuilt Weatherlight and is a friend of Karn, Teferi and Jodah.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

bio.text: She had the wreck of the Weatherlight raised and its hull regrown, then recruited a crew that included Shanna, Raff and Arvad, with Ajani as the expected friend.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

bio.text: As captain she opposed Belzenlok and the Cabal, met her former lover Jodah at the academy, and reunited with her old friend Teferi.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

bio.text: She revealed that she held Teferi's planeswalker spark in a Powerstone she had made, and she dropped the pendant into his palm when he chose to take it back.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

bio.text: She led the Weatherlight against the Stronghold, and at the end she and Tiana kept their crew together on the grounds that the bargain with the Church of Serra required eradicating the Cabal from all of Dominaria.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

bio.text: Later she wrote unanswered letters urging Karn to return, reconciled with him in her workshop on the Mana Rig, and planned its self-destruct mechanism.

citations.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.
"Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

bio.text: She woke the Mana Rig, which flooded the Phyrexians with lava, and then triggered its self-destruct and ordered Jodah to portal everyone out.

citations.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citations.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

citations.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citations.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

bio.text: She helped build a monument to Jaya in Shiv's desert and afterward spoke with Jodah through a cloud of mercury, asking whether Teferi was still bent on going back in time.

citations.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

status.text: As of the latest story she is alive, in contact with Jodah, and Karn calls her his best friend.

"The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn asks Jhoira why Urza built the machine to be like him if it was meant to be nothing but a machine.
timeline.quote: why did Urza build it to be like me?

citation.text: Beast of Burden (Urza's Legacy Promos, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi snaps his fingers and a viashino begins clucking like a chicken.
timeline.quote: Teferi snapped his fingers, and the viashino started clucking like a chicken.

citation.text: Bewilder (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Hadi spot the wreck of the Weatherlight on the sea floor.
timeline.quote: the long spine half-buried in the muck and waterweeds was too straight for any natural formation

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira hires the Vodalian Ziva to raise the Weatherlight within a day for double pay.
timeline.quote: The price is doubled if you can bring it up within two days,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira views the raised wreck of the Weatherlight on a Bogardan beach.
timeline.quote: Jhoira stood on the shore looking at what was left of the great skyship

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana is moved by the Weatherlight's skeleton, recognizing it as Gerrard's blade.
timeline.quote: It's Gerrard's blade in the portraits.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira notices Tiana crying and suspects her reaction is tied to the ship.
timeline.quote: Why are you crying?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The salvagers prepare a hull seed from Molimo and examine the Powerstone.
timeline.quote: a new hull seed Jhoira had obtained from the tree elemental Molimo

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana revives the inert Powerstone.
timeline.quote: Jhoira felt the shift in the Powerstone, the moment when it came to life again.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira asks Tiana to oversee the reconstruction while she gathers a crew, and Tiana agrees.
timeline.quote: No, I need someone to supervise the reconstruction and protect the workers while I gather a crew.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira sails to Suq'Ata to find a potential crew member.
timeline.quote: she took her barque to the coast of Jamuraa first, to the city of Suq'Ata

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: A panicked man reports a Cabal spy in the treasury of the Sarin Mercantile.
timeline.quote: A Cabal spy in the treasury of the Sarin Mercantile!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira watches through her owl as a swordswoman fights Cabal agents on a warehouse roof.
timeline.quote: one woman with a sword fought half a dozen men wearing the concealing robes of desert nomads.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira recognizes the woman's immunity to magic.
timeline.quote: It was an immunity to magic, and she had seen it before.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira reveals she knew Shanna's ancestor Captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: I knew your ancestor, Captain Sisay. I see you carry her sword.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira introduces herself to Shanna.
timeline.quote: I'm Jhoira. I came here to find you.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna agrees to serve on the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then I would consider it an honor to have you on my crew.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Danitha Capashen refuses to join, bound to defend Benalia.
timeline.quote: I'm sworn to defend this land.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff Capashen volunteers to go in his sister's place.
timeline.quote: I'm a Capashen. I'm Raff.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira exposes Raff's lie about Jodah.
timeline.quote: Jodah did not say that.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff shows his skill by creating an illusion of the original Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: In the distance the original version of the Weatherlight angled across the sky.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira recruits Raff.
timeline.quote: If you want to come, pack hurriedly.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight is restored and ready to launch.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight was whole and ready to launch.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The vampire Arvad swears to serve Jhoira.
timeline.quote: I swear to serve at your side, Captain Jhoira.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane arrives, the friend Jhoira was waiting for.
timeline.quote: With a rush of wind and golden light, Ajani Goldmane appeared on the shore.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana tells Arvad that Jhoira is the legendary one and the legends are true.
timeline.quote: She is that Jhoira, and those aren't legends, they're all true.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana resolves to serve on the Weatherlight when Jhoira returns.
timeline.quote: It wasn't the purpose she had been born for, but it was the one she wanted more than anything.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani meets Jhoira aboard the finished Weatherlight and asks about the planeswalkers he told her of.
timeline.quote: Thank you for meeting me here,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Jhoira that Karn was rescued from the Phyrexians and has returned to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Were you aware the Planeswalker called Karn was found and rescued from the Phyrexians?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Venser gave up his spark to save Karn and died.
timeline.quote: Venser gave up his spark to Karn, to rescue him. Venser did not survive.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers the Weatherlight's help to destroy Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: I've had this ship reconstructed for the sole purpose of fighting the Cabal

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group resolves to capture a high-level Cabal agent for intelligence about the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We need to capture a high-level Cabal agent.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff suggests Tolaria West, where Cabal agents are rumored.
timeline.quote: The last time I was in Tolaria West, there were rumors about Cabal agents in the academy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira tenses when she sees her ex-lover Jodah at the academy.
timeline.quote: Just an ex-lover I wasn't expecting to see today.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah, Dean Naban and Tolarian mages meet the Weatherlight's group.
timeline.quote: In the lead were an older man with hard features and a deceptively young-looking mage with a mane of brown hair.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah brings them to see something at the academy.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure how much we can help you, but there's something we'd like you to take a look at.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah finds the box holding the ancient artifact empty.
timeline.quote: It's gone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: A student named Thom emerges and claims he was studying.
timeline.quote: I'm Thom, studying artificing with Dr. Arongi.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira shatters the globe with a barrier.
timeline.quote: Jhoira moved so fast it was like she had teleported.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah asks Jhoira to stay and help hunt Cabal cultists, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: You could stay here and help us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff offers a forbidden spell to draw out the agent's thoughts.
timeline.quote: It involves drawing individual thoughts out of someone's brain.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Blackblade killed an elder dragon.
timeline.quote: It killed an elder dragon.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira describes the Blackblade as a soul-drinker made with death magic.
timeline.quote: But it's a soul-drinker, created with death magic, and steals the life-energy of everyone it kills.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira says she knows a time mage who can help.
timeline.quote: But I know just the time mage who can.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira introduces Gideon and Liliana as planeswalkers to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Liliana are Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira asks Teferi for a time mage to help them enter the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill Belzenlok and we need a time mage to help us get into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira notes Teferi later returned Shiv and lost his planeswalker spark doing so.
timeline.quote: That's how he lost his Planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira theorizes Urza cheated, and Liliana looks for ghosts in the chamber.
timeline.quote: Worse, I think he cheated,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana detects trapped spirits that factor into the puzzle.
timeline.quote: Aha, there are spirits here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi hits the correct square and the platform opens.
timeline.quote: the square in the center slid ponderously aside to reveal an opening.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi agrees to join Jhoira in saving the world again.
timeline.quote: I think I will.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Niambi is dropped home and blesses her father's return to adventuring.
timeline.quote: This is what you were born to do.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira reveals she holds Teferi's planeswalker spark in a Powerstone and must convince him to take it back.
timeline.quote: It held Teferi's Planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi greets Karn aboard the Weatherlight, and Jhoira says Ajani told her of Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira shows Teferi the Powerstone locket holding his spark and asks him to take it back, so he can help kill Bolas.
timeline.quote: "The Mana Rig." She held it out to him. "Will you take it back?"

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi decides to take back his spark, and Jhoira drops the pendant into his palm.
timeline.quote: She pulled the pendant off her neck and dropped it into Teferi's waiting palm. "Welcome back."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Jhoira he does not regret giving up his spark.
timeline.quote: I regret a lot of things. But not that.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers to take Jaya to the Academy in Tolaria West, and Jaya says she is not sure how back she is yet.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure just how back I am yet, if you know what I mean.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira decides to take the thallids back to Yavimaya when possible, accepting them aboard.
timeline.quote: I must have brought them here with Molimo's seed, so we'll have to take them back to Yavimaya when we have a chance.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
timeline.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Urborg resistance's hidden base and that her owl has arranged a meeting.
timeline.quote: And the resistance has agreed to meet with us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Gideon meet resistance members including the panther warrior Sayrah, and ask for Cabal clothing and a map of past battle sites.
timeline.quote: First, the clothing of a Cabal scout or fighter, someone who would be hunting Urborg for captives to take to the Stronghold's fighting pit.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana's panther liches pledge to follow the Weatherlight into battle.
timeline.quote: They'll follow the ship into battle.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle rises from the swamp, a living creature that killed all the panther warriors, and flings itself at the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then Yargle roared and flung itself at the Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana saves Jhoira from falling from the tilting deck.
timeline.quote: Liliana managed to wedge herself between the deck and the rail, gripping Jhoira's arm to keep her from falling.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira's owl drops a mana-charged burner on Yargle, but it fails to dislodge the creature.
timeline.quote: Yargle still gripped the bow, and now its gigantic maw was opening.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental, rises behind Yargle and seizes it.
timeline.quote: It's Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira directs the ship to the Stronghold after Slimefoot's call for help succeeds.
timeline.quote: Jhoira agreed. It was time to end this. "To the Stronghold."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.
timeline.quote: Teferi held out his hand and the gate across the causeway turned red with corrosion, then dissolved in a puff of rust.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira realizes Urgoros is only a distraction, and the spirits build a tower of bodies to lower Liliana to the ground.
timeline.quote: They kept coming, the tower of spirit bodies rising higher and higher.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Tiana keep their crew together by deciding the bargain with the Church of Serra requires eradicating the Cabal from all of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: I thought it was to eradicate the Cabal from all of Dominaria.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn repairs a broken excavator in the Caves of Koilos and recalls Jhoira doubting that the Phyrexians are on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Karn placed his hand on the excavator.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn returns to camp, where Jhoira's unanswered letters lie, and examines the sylex, which shocks him.
timeline.quote: The sylex sent a jolt through him.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani digs Karn out of the cave-in, explaining Jhoira had a tracking spell on her letters, and tells Karn he has been buried for months.
timeline.quote: She asked Raff to place a tracking spell on the letters

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn builds a scrying device and finds he cannot scry Sheoldred; Ajani gives him a copy of the amulet to summon the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: They must have protections in place to prevent us from scrying them.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn secretly moves the sylex from his room to Jhoira's workshop on the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: He stowed the sylex and its case on the lowest shelf behind lengths of pipe

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz destroys a Phyrexian monster attacking the Weatherlight over Shiv and accepts Teferi's proposal to fight.
timeline.quote: "I accept your proposal to fight here at Shiv.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn and Jhoira reconcile in her workshop and she plans a self-destruct mechanism for the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: "Ah, I missed you." Jhoira laughed and embraced him.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jhoira's cannons fire twice and bring down a Phyrexian dreadnought.
timeline.quote: It collapsed onto its own troops, crushing them.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jhoira wakes the Mana Rig, which stands and tears free, strides across the desert and floods the Phyrexians with lava.
timeline.quote: The Mana Rig was free.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jhoira triggers the Mana Rig's self-destruct mechanism and orders Jodah to portal everyone out.
timeline.quote: Jhoira had triggered the Mana Rig's self-destruct mechanism.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.
